subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: If the severity-map policy is malformed (unknown keys, unparseable), then the system shall emit a `configuration-error` verdict naming the policy defect, with zero checks run; a *missing* policy falls back to the built-in default map (the `#D-4` split), never fails
fit_criterion: the malformed-severity-map fixture yields configuration-error naming the defect; the absent-policy fixture runs on the default split
